description: Use this when the user asks to see a card ("show me Lightning Bolt", "what does Rhystic Study look like?") or to compare a few: up to 8 cards, each drawn with its picture, mana cost, type line, rules text and printing, and its Scryfall link. A name may be in any language Scryfall prints; the card comes back under its English `name`, and `asked` keeps what was asked: when they differ, say which card it is ("Foudre is Lightning Bolt"). A bare name shows the printing the name means; give set_code and collector_number for one printing. This is a preview of the card, not of the player's copies: it says nothing about what they own (where_is and show_card_location do). Each card in `not_found` was not found: say so, with its `error`. Link each card's name to its `scryfall_url`. A name newer than the catalogue is looked up on Scryfall; a scryfall_id is read from the catalogue alone.

cards.description: The cards to show, 1 to 8: each by name (any language) or scryfall_id, optionally with set_code + collector_number

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known

name: show_card

asked.description: What was asked: a name in any language, an id, or a set and number. When it is not `name`, say which card it is

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

set_name.description: The set's name; null when the set list does not hold it yet

not_found.description: Cards asked for and not found: say so

error.description: Why it was not found, and what to do

title: Show a card
